title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Sand Taupe’ delivers yet another in a long line of neutral colorways that have dominate the silhouette’s many releases since its global debut in 2016. Decorative no-tie laces are integrated into to the breathable Primeknit upper, featuring a patchwork-like pattern and a prominent seam that runs down the length of the vamp. On the lateral side panel, coral fibers are woven into the knit construction above the post-dyed monofilament side stripe for a subtle pop of color. A fully caged Boost midsole provides lightweight cushioning.

title: YEEZY BASKETBALL KNIT
description: The adidas Yeezy Basketball Knit ‘Slate Blue’ represents the debut colorway of Kanye West’s new hoops shoe. Varying shades of blue are executed on the Primeknit upper, secured with rope laces and a stretchy high-cut collar that delivers a sock-like fit. Rearfoot support is provided by a prominent heel counter borrowed from the Yeezy Quantum. The breathable knit build is mounted on a full-length Boost midsole, wrapped in a semi-translucent cage and reinforced by a herringbone-traction rubber outsole. Runs small, order a half size up.
